notes: New: FilmCraft Editor — a real pro multitrack NLE inside OrbitStudio, powered by the open-source FilmCraft engine (pure Rust, MIT/Apache-2.0): media bin, program monitor, multitrack timeline with razor cuts (linked audio follows), ripple delete, roll-trim by dragging edit points, clip drag-to-move, markers, undo/redo, timecode-accurate playback. Export straight from the timeline: H.264, H.265, ProRes, WAV, hardware encoding Auto (NVENC on RTX 5070 Ti) with live progress + cancel. Projects save as .fcproj. Engine ships as filmcraft_orbit_ffi.dll beside the exe; attribution in THIRD-PARTY-FILMCRAFT.txt.
